ShortDescription.Value: Draw a shape and get a finished parking lot inside it: bays, aisles, cross roads and surfaces. The cars really park in it.

Publish.LongDescription:
Draw a shape on the ground and the mod fills it with a complete parking lot: parking bays, driving aisles, cross roads, a road around the edge and the ground surfaces in between. The bays are real parking lanes, so cars actually drive in and park there - they are not decoration.
# How to use it
1. Click the parking icon in the mod bar at the top left, or press Ctrl+P. 2. Left click sets the corners of your area, right click takes the last one back. Click the first corner again to close the shape. 3. Place at least one entrance where the lot should meet an existing road. 4. Press Enter, or the Build button.
Before you build you can drag any corner or any edge to reshape the lot, and the preview follows. Finished lots can be reopened later with the Edit button - outline, entrances and every setting stay changeable. ESC leaves the tool.
# Ways in and out
An entrance can be two-way, or an entry and an exit as separate one-lane ramps, or a pedestrian access. You can also place an alley, which is a visible road rather than a hidden one, in both directions or as a one-way pair.
Entrances snap to the aisle they serve, so the ramp lines up with the lane behind it instead of meeting it at an angle.
# What you can change
**Layout** - edge setback, row angle (follow an edge, a fixed angle, or align to a polygon line), aisle width, cross road width, and a cross road every N bays.
**Green** - a median between the bay rows and how deep it is, the perimeter road, and the small grass caps where a row meets a cross road. Switch the caps off and the bays sit straight against the cross road instead.
**Surfaces** - pick any surface in the game for the driving area and for everything in between, including surfaces added by asset mods, or switch either one off and paint the ground yourself. The lot can extend its surface out to the road it connects to.
**Vegetation** - trees and bushes on the green, with density and age.
**Bay markings** - the painted stall markings, on or off.
Every value can be saved as your own default, so the next lot starts the way you like it.
# Zoning
A parking lot can carry building land. Draw a zoning patch inside the lot and the mod lays a road around it, with the parcels facing whichever side you choose - that choice decides where the buildings put their entrance. Each side of that road can also carry a band of parcels on its outside, as deep as you like in 8 m tiles, and the lot keeps that ground free of bays and aisles.
# It runs as part of the city
Each lot reports its spaces and how many are taken, charges a parking fee you set, and costs upkeep. The whole thing can be switched off in the options if you would rather have the geometry without the economy.
# Good to know
- The whole lot has a single owner: one click selects it, one bulldoze removes it. - The panel is English by default. German can be chosen in the mod options. - Before you unsubscribe, the options have an Uninstall button that removes every lot this mod built and leaves the save clean. - Something looks wrong? The "Report a problem" tab marks the spot in the world and writes a short file you can send along. If the game ever crashes, a report is written by itself.
# Requirements
Unified Icon Library and Asset Icon Library. Both are picked up automatically.
# Source
The full source is on GitHub under GPL-3.0. This mod was written with AI assistance and I would rather say so than have someone find out. That is not the same as letting a model improvise until it compiles: the repository documents what was measured, what was decompiled and which wrong turns cost days. You are welcome to check.
